# Tower Control development frames

Lossless PNG crops are from the user's local 1920×1080 development videos,
cropped at pixel bounds x=450–1470, y=105–205 (right and bottom exclusive).
They are development examples, not independent validation data.

- `museum_30.png`: `en-live-playerview-2026-10-11 22-20-42.mov`, video 30 s.
  The anchor marker is at approximately x=960; a background cue near x=572
  previously displaced it.
- `makomart_110.png`: `en-live-playerview-2026-10-11 18-18-00.mov`, video 110 s.
  The colored marker is at approximately x=1027.
